verdict.rationale: Requiring approval before specific tool calls is a fair axis for an agent orchestration framework. The pack, however, shows no documented per-tool approval gate in CrewAI. The only related item is a POST /resume endpoint to 'Resume crew execution with human feedback', which is crew-level feedback rather than a gate on sensitive tool calls, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit. A competitor's community comment also says CrewAI lacks deterministic pause hooks.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can require human approval before specific sensitive tool calls execute
